topic: What are the trade-offs in using additive manufacturing for CTS array fabrication versus traditional methods in terms of deployment cost and scalability?
consensus_response: Additive manufacturing (AM) offers design freedom, reducing assembly complexity and labor costs, but introduces surface roughness, degrading microwave performance. Traditional methods provide precision, minimizing losses, but struggle with complex geometries, limiting scalability. Electromagnetic simulations can optimize designs, mitigating performance issues.
reference_context: Additive manufacturing enables monolithic structures, while traditional methods ensure precise control over dimensions and surface finish, impacting deployment cost and scalability in SatCom applications.
